release_notes: `static/composer.js`: `bootstrap.Modal#hide()` no-ops while the modal is still mid-open-transition (`_isTransitioning`), so a fast save round-trip could leave `#saveModal` stuck open. `hideSaveModal()` now queues the hide for `shown.bs.modal` instead of calling it immediately. `app.py`: `strategy_composer_page()` gained a `?ai_configured=0` override so UI tests can force the not-configured provider-dropdown branch without touching the real BYOK credential store. `tests/ui`: performance dashboard fixture referenced a strategy archived in real `strategies/metadata.json` (the KPI filter is server-rendered, not mockable) — swapped to an active one; AI-handoff test updated for the `?ai_configured=0` override.
